IRV.Controls.OpenVisionPanel: Immersive and Realistic Views – settings for selected token
IRV.Panel.Title: Immersive and Realistic Views
IRV.Panel.SelectOneToken: Please select exactly one token on the canvas first.
IRV.Panel.SelectOnlyOneToken: Please select only one token to edit its vision profile.
IRV.Panel.NoPermission: You do not have permission to change this token's vision settings.
IRV.Panel.NoTokenHint: Close this window, select a token on the canvas, then click the eye icon in the Token tools again.
IRV.Panel.RealisticDescription: Distant image detail is reduced in small token-anchored pixel blocks. Blocks fade out individually and at staggered distances instead of forming one continuous blurred ring.
IRV.Panel.ImmersiveDescription: Changes peripheral perception with softening, desaturation, and subtle darkening.
IRV.Panel.UseNativeRange: Use this token's native Vision Range
IRV.Panel.RangeHint: Fallback distance is used only when native Vision Range is unavailable, zero, or unlimited.
IRV.Panel.TokenOnlyNote: These values are stored on this token only. Actor senses and rules-based perception values are not changed.
IRV.Panel.Save: Save vision profile for this token
IRV.Panel.Saved: Vision profile saved for the selected token.
IRV.Panel.SaveFailed: Could not save the vision profile. See the browser console for details.
IRV.Panel.DissolveSpreadHint: Distributes the fade across individual pixel blocks. Higher values stagger block disappearance more widely instead of creating one smooth wave edge.
IRV.Panel.DarknessDescription: Adds extra darkness to the map area beyond the selected token’s vision range.
IRV.Panel.DarknessHint: Darkness increases through the outer edge to the selected strength. At 100%, areas beyond the vision range become nearly black. Foundry still controls walls and Fog of War; this setting changes presentation only.
IRV.Panel.MultiTokenHint: When multiple tokens are selected, the first selected token's settings are applied to all selected tokens.
IRV.Panel.EchoDescription: Also enables Foundry's Feel Tremor detection and a visible echo pulse. True wall reflections remain under development.
IRV.Panel.BoundaryWidthHint: How far the darkening extends into the actual vision area.
IRV.Panel.BoundaryOpacity: Black opacity at the vision edge
